phrases.latin: tunicās, brācās, pedūlia, subūculās, vestēs nocturnās, thōrācēs lāneōs, pilleum, paenulam ūnam; nam duās ipse voluerat, ūnam māter jusserat
phrases.english: shirts, trousers, socks, vests, pyjamas, woollen jumpers, a cap, one coat: he had wanted two, Mum had said one

laneus.html: Lewis & Short s.v. lāneus, citing the woollen thōrāx of Suet. Aug. 82; the libellī write lāneus.
